title: Bob Lazar at S4, 1989

tellings.quote: you only have one Bob Lazar, a guy who actually you know at S4 in 1989 said he worked on the craft itself.

plain: A man named Bob Lazar says that in 1989 he worked on an actual alien craft at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert. Michels brings him up himself, saying Lazar is the only person who has claimed to have worked hands-on with a craft. That would make him a rare inside witness to the government studying alien technology.
